Tier Green

Effect the next ally who acts on your signal before the start of your next turn gains +1 circumstance to their attack roll

A called coordinated strike boosts the ally who acts on it.

cinderfall.incomplete: The next ally to act on the caster's signal gets +1 circumstance to their attack roll. Same gap as eyes-up: no companion effect for this slug, and a bare ally numeric bonus doesn't match the real mass-action-grant precedent.
